summary: #487: end-to-end route from actual existence to a necessarily underived ground. First tried composing NECESSARY-CONCRETE-FROM-ACTUAL-GROUNDED with NECESSARY-UNDERIVED-POSITIVE-LIFT. Rejected: that needs well-foundedness of support by all existing supporters, stronger than the restricted ActualGroundingWF, and lifting. Used instead: a direct step from the necessary root witness itself. Finding 1: rootness does not transfer. A necessary actual root can fail to be underived in three separate ways (rotating support, possible contingent support, abstract support), each with the earlier premises holding. Finding 2: the necessity clause of NecessaryPredecessorLifting is not used by this route; the weaker NecessarySupportIsPresent suffices, with a model of all five premises where lifting fails. Finding 3: restricted well-foundedness does not reach abstract supporters, so the route needs ActualSupportersConcrete, and without it an abstract cycle defeats the conclusion. Finding 4: under the premises every actual concretum descends from an underived root, which is the route's explanatory reach; but in one model of all five premises two such roots have no ancestry either way and a ground exists where its effect does not. So the premises give neither unity nor effect-entailment. Rejected reading: treating a root's absence of actual concrete grounds as absence of explanation. The rival labels (brute root, circular or endless support, world-varying support, abstract support) name models; no author's view is reported, and Pruss, Oppy and Craig witnesses listed on #487 remain unread. #553's reverse direction was already certified by NECESSARY-OR-NONNECESSARY-ROOT, so nothing was added for it. The connection to the root route is in ATTEMPT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-ROUTE-487's PR. Same-witness direct-esse audit(2026-10-31): the already-built core theorem UnderivedRootRoute.underivedOfNecessaryRoot accepts the supplied n,ActualRoot m w n and NecessaryAt m.ontic w n, plus existing NecessarySupportIsPresent and ActualSupportersConcrete, and returns UnderivedRootAt for that identical n. The NamedNecessarilyUnderived m.ontic m.grounds w n endpoint is the direct projection of actual presence, necessity and that no-existing-support conjunct. Thus the new eight-input DIRECT-ESSE-ROOT-UNIQUENESS endpoint can retain its same witness and actual uniqueness while adding exactly those two open interfaces, with no fresh WF, union-WF, actual-reflexivity, no-contingent-support or logical assumption. Named absence and NecessarySupportIsPresent both quantify over ALL admitted worlds, including inaccessible ones; accessibility-only support transport does not meet that type. ActualSupportersConcrete quantifies over arbitrary actual supporters, not just supplied esse causes. ExistingInActAt and EsseCauseIsActualConcreteGround cover selected actual causal applications and do not establish either added interface. NecessaryConcreteUnderived.checks is a different reusable certificate that may choose a different necessary final witness and excludes only concrete supporters; it cannot directly supply this same-n unrestricted-support endpoint. Existing rotating/absent/abstract-support controls already record the scope gaps; no duplicate model or new proof artifact was added. Actual uniqueness remains at selected w, not uniqueness of every other world source; no all-world outgoing causal coverage or complete explanation follows. No premise independently defended or discharged, no frontier argument rewired.
blocker: No defence for any real relation of the closing premise, restricted well-foundedness, present support or concrete supporters. No route premise consumes STMT-NECESSARILY-UNDERIVED, so the route does not lower a root cost. For the direct-esse same witness, independently justify all-world support transport back to actual w and actual concreteness of arbitrary existing supporters of that necessary actual concretum. Accessible-world transport alone is insufficient for NamedNecessarilyUnderived, whose absence ranges over all admitted worlds.
